'''Bart Ouwehand''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[1999 Ryloth Regionals]] on 11 September 1999 with [[Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|MWYHL with retrieval and damage reducers]], according to Koen Meijssen's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d161">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-08-ryloth-regional-kaatsheuvel-11-9-1999d161/ ryloth-regional-kaatsheuvel-11-9-1999], DeckTech (Koen "Mr. Pink" Meijssen, 8 January 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-08-ryloth-regional-kaatsheuvel-11-9-1999d161/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
